summary: Tested 6 admin panel fixes for 4Luis crowdfunding platform. All 6 fixes verified working correctly: (1) Viagens nav link scrolls to #journeys section, (2) Admin login redirects to /admin, (3) Suspend button with EyeOff icon present, (4) Storytelling fields are editable after AI generation, (5) Set main star button with Principal badge, (6) Anunciar Novo Sonho dropdown with journey selector.
passed_tests: TEST 1: Nav 'Viagens' (data-testid='nav-journeys') clicks and scrolls to section id='journeys' on homepage
TEST 2: Admin login (admin@4luis.com / Admin1) redirects to /admin page, not /dashboard
TEST 3: Journey list shows suspend button (data-testid='suspend-btn-{journey_id}') with EyeOff icon for active journeys
TEST 4a: Storytelling chapter title fields (data-testid='story-chapter-title-{1-5}') are editable <input> elements
TEST 4b: Can type and edit story chapter title content (changed 'O Início' to 'Test Edit Title')
TEST 4c: Storytelling chapter text fields (data-testid='story-chapter-text-{1-5}') are editable <textarea> elements
TEST 5a: Journey list shows 'set main' star button (data-testid='set-main-btn-{journey_id}')
TEST 5b: Main journey (China) shows 'Principal' badge (data-testid='main-badge-journey_china001') and filled gold star
TEST 6a: 'Anunciar Novo Sonho' button (data-testid='announce-dream-btn') opens dropdown
TEST 6b: Dropdown (data-testid='announce-select-dropdown') shows journey selector with 7 active journeys
TEST 6c: Dropdown shows only active journeys (Japão, Vietname, Paris, Londres, Coreia do Sul, Martinique, Maldivas)
TEST 7: Edit button (data-testid='edit-btn-{journey_id}') opens JourneyEditForm successfully
TEST 8: Delete button (data-testid='delete-btn-{journey_id}') present and clickable
critical_code_review_comments: Login.js (line 43-48): Admin redirect logic working correctly - checks userData?.is_admin and navigates to /admin
Header.js (line 75-85): Viagens nav link properly handles scroll with scrollIntoView and navigates with ?scrollTo=journeys param
Home.js (line 53-61): scrollTo param handler correctly scrolls to section after 500ms delay
Admin.js handleToggleSuspend (line 174-186): Properly toggles is_active via PUT /api/admin/journeys/{id}
Admin.js handleSetMainTrip (line 188-206): Correctly sets is_main_trip=true on selected and false on all others
Admin.js announce dropdown (line 728-764): Filters journeys by is_active && !announcement_email_sent
JourneyEditForm.js TabStorytelling (line 244-311): Uses editable <input> for title and <textarea> for text
seed_data_creation: None - used existing journeys (journey_china001, journey_japan001, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 admin panel fixes verified: (1) Viagens nav scroll, (2) admin redirect to /admin, (3) suspend button with EyeOff/Eye icons, (4) editable storytelling fields, (5) set main star button with Principal badge, (6) Anunciar Novo Sonho dropdown. Key data-testids: nav-journeys, suspend-btn-{id}, set-main-btn-{id}, main-badge-{id}, suspended-badge-{id}, announce-dream-btn, announce-select-dropdown, announce-journey-{id}, edit-btn-{id}, delete-btn-{id}, story-chapter-title-{1-5}, story-chapter-text-{1-5}. Journey IDs: journey_china001 (main), journey_japan001, etc.

features_verified.details: Click on 'Viagens' nav link scrolls to section id='journeys' on homepage
Admin users redirected to /admin instead of /dashboard after login
Suspend button shows EyeOff for active, Eye for suspended journeys
Chapter title (input) and text (textarea) are editable after AI generation
Star button sets journey as main, shows filled gold star and 'Principal' badge
Dropdown shows active journeys that haven't been announced yet
